messages.author: ef7473141f9b3961
messages.subject: crashing when loading package
parts:
Hello,

New on the list and it has been a while since I looked at Distance so there is some catching up involved.

I am trying to run Distance 7.1 with R3.3.0 (and 3.3.2). Initially there was a problem getting the right packages sorted out as my default R was 64-bit. Got past that and now the packages appear in the list in RStudio. Whenever I try to run one of the sample datasets (with 32-bit R), it crashes the front end (RStudio and R-Gui). It seems to be the library() command, as if the packages are not being found.

This is likely an installation issue rather than a bug and would appreciate advice on this.

Thanks

Paul

messages.author: f2122b34f1aa6e95
messages.subject: Re: [distance-sampling] crashing when loading package
parts:
Paul

Can you clarify what you are trying to do?

Distance 7.1 is a stand-alone programme that operates from the Windows operating system, with its own graphical user interface.  It is not intended to be run using RStudio or R-GUI.

In contrast, there is an R package, called Distance that you can download from CRAN and run from within RStudio or R-GUI.

So I'm confused when you say Distance 7.1 is crashing RStudio.  What sample dataset are you trying to run when your problems arise?  There are a number of datasets that ship with Distance 7.1, but running these with Distance 7.1 should not involve RStudio.

Provide a bit more detail and we'll try to sort you out.


------

parts:
Hi Eric, 

Sorry I was not clear in the first case. I started using Distance 7.1 stand-alone. When it kept crashing I then tested the Distance package in RGui and RStudio.

In Distance 7.1 the log shows that the last command issued was library(mrds) or (dsm). It then crashes with "R for Windows terminal front end has stopped working" 
The log includes:
> source('C:\\Program Files (x86)\\Distance 7\\support.r')
> install.distance.packages(dir='C:\\Program Files (x86)\\Distance 7\\RPackages\\')
> library(mrds)

-- End of Analyis Engine Log File -- 
Analysis engine status 'Run failed - analysis engine encountered an unknown error, possibly in the input or output files' 
Reading Results 
Could not read the results file.  Results not saved. 
Run finished 

and the results message is
** Error: Analysis engine terminated unexpectedly (with error code -1073741819).  **
 
This is similar in cases with different model specifications using both mrds and dsm. Problems come using sample datasets; dolphins and golftees, but not with amahicki, ducknest, house wren. I assume because different packages may be required?

I tried again, using library(Distance) in Rstudio. 
In the console I get:
> library(Distance)
package �Distance� was built under R version 3.3.3Loading required package: mrds
package �mrds� was built under R version 3.4.1

followed by the 'Bomb' popup, R session aborted, restart R session?

In RGui the library(Distance) command crashes with "R for Windows GUI front-end has stopped working"

As I noted initially, it seems to be that loading the required packages (mrds and dsm, possibly others) that crashes it.

Paul

messages.subject: Re[2]: [distance-sampling] crashing when loading package
parts:
Thanks for the clarification Paul, that is helpful.

When performing analyses using R, you can analyse the ducknest, house wren and amakihi data sets just using the Distance package (that also loads the mrds package).  The dolphins dataset also requires the dsm package.

Note that the mrds package was built under R 3.4.1, and you say you have R 3.3.0 and 3.3.2 on your machines.  My suspicion lies in the need for you to update your version of R to at least 3.4.1 (although 3.4.2 is now available).  See if that resolves your problems.
